jobs.title: Success Systems Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

We are investing in a Success Systems Specialist to transform how Skydio delivers its post-sales experience — both internally and to our customers. This is a systems architect/builder role designed to embed automation, intelligence, and digital experiences into our support environment.

As part of the Skydio Center of Excellence, you will be the connective tissue between our critical tools and databases, our customer-facing support portal, and other key digital experiences. Your work will ensure that Skydio Mission Success scales faster than headcount, delivers more intelligent workflows for advocates, and provides digital-first experiences for customers that increasingly utilize practical AI-powered assistants.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, design, and operations — requiring both deep technical fluency and the cross-functional credibility to align with Mission Success, Field Services, Product Support, Analytics, and Revenue Ops.

Why This Role Matters Now:

  • Skydio’s product and system complexity is scaling faster than our current support tooling.

  • Customers expect digital-first, data-rich, proactive support.

  • This role is the lever that ensures we scale globally without ballooning support costs.

  • By surfacing insights, automating workflows, and digitizing the customer journey, this position transforms customer success and support from cost centers into competitive differentiators.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Build Automation & Intelligence into Mission Success

  • Architect integrations between Salesforce Service Console/Field Service, Skydio Cloud APIs, Palantir, and other internal tooling to surface telemetry and analytics directly to advocates and customers.

  • Create automated workflows and diagnostics that reduce repetitive manual work, accelerate case resolution, and cut operational costs.

Customer Digital Experience

  • Lead the build-out of Skydio’s next-gen support operations portal — enabling customers to see case status, telemetry insights, training/warranty policies, and troubleshooting resources in one unified experience.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders in Mission Success, Field Services, and Product to ensure a 360° digital experience across the customer journey.

Cross-Functional Architecture & Governance

  • Act as a bridge across silos, ensuring unified systems design across Support, Success, Field Services, Skydio Cloud, and Revenue Ops.

  • Establish best practices for API use, Mission Success systems architecture, and data governance.

  • Provide project-level leadership, writing BRDs, roadmaps, user stories, and guiding cross-team delivery.

Scalability & Cost Avoidance

  • Deliver solutions that expand support capacity without exponential headcount growth.

  • Quantify and communicate ROI of new systems — showing measurable efficiency gains and cost savings.

What makes you a good fit:

  • A business process and systems thinker with both technical fluency and a passion for improving the human experience of support.

  • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and data pipelines (REST, ETL, middleware, Palantir, SQL, and Salesforce).

  • Proven capacity to architect AI-driven integrations (e.g., Palantir, ChatGPT) that enhance workflow automation and business intelligence.

  • Experience designing customer-facing digital experiences (customer portals, self-service tools, workflow automation, customer adoption, and training/knowledge transfer).

  • Proven ability to operate at the project manager level: writing requirements, running sprints, aligning stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with customer success processes (training, warranty, field service) and how they interconnect with support.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the credibility to work across technical, Success, Field Services, and executive audiences.

  • 2+ years of Salesforce Service Console and/or Experience Cloud administration; Salesforce certifications highly desired.

  • Familiarity with data warehousing/analytics platforms (e.g., Palantir, Databricks, Snowflake, SQL). You are not afraid of a massive Google or Office spreadsheet and have some familiarity with relational database products and concepts (e.g., SQL, Relational Data Model).

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical, operations, and GTM teams in an extremely agile environment.

  • Ability to lead technical projects end-to-end: scoping requirements, writing BRDs, coordinating development, and tracking delivery. You can write a Project Charter or Business Systems Requirement Document (BRD) to help direct working groups, and are capable of tracking complex projects via Jira sprints, GANTT charts, or other standard systems of record.

  • Comfort with agile methods (sprints, backlogs, Jira) and balancing multiple priorities.

  • Strong communicator who can bridge the gap between engineers, support agents, and leadership stakeholders.

  • Experience with Notion, Google Suite, Salesforce, or Netsuite is a plus.

  • (Nice to have) Familiarity with Experience Cloud/customer portal design and user experience principles.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

jobs.title: Aviation Regulatory Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role

We are seeking a world-class Aviation Regulatory Program Manager to join our Global Aviation Regulatory team. You will execute regulatory strategy to secure and sustain operational approvals that enable advanced, autonomous drone operations in the U.S. and globally.

This is the opportunity of a lifetime. Skydio is the largest American drone company whose products are used by thousands of organizations across critical infrastructure, public safety, energy utilities and many sectors. We believe our regulatory team is the best in the world, led by pioneers who have secured groundbreaking approvals in the U.S. and other countries.

If you want to break regulatory barriers, enable life-saving missions, and join a rocket-ship company that is transforming drone technology, this is the job for you.

How You’ll Make an Impact

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of technology, regulation, and real-world deployment of autonomous systems, where you will:

  • Develop, submit, and defend aviation regulatory operational approval requests, waivers, exemptions, and declarations that enable safe and scalable drone operations.

  • Be a trusted resource and guide for our customers and partners pursuing advanced regulatory projects.

  • Develop and maintain scalable systems to track and oversee the implementation of regulatory projects.

  • Translate emerging regulations into clear internal guidance and actionable plans.

  • Support key product demonstrations and technical validation events in coordination with the flight testing and solutions engineering teams.

  • Provide regulatory advice to the customer support, product management, and engineering teams to ensure the compliant, safe, and scalable use of Skydio’s hardware and software products.

  • Serve as a point of contact with civil aviation authorities (FAA and global regulators), representing Skydio in regulatory reviews, audits, and compliance discussions.

  • Contribute to standards development and represent Skydio in industry bodies and consensus forums.

What Makes You a Good Fit

  • Bachelor’s degree in aviation, engineering, public policy, or a related field or equivalent experience.

  • Passion for aviation, autonomy, and creating solutions that drive real impact. Having both manned and unmanned aviation experience is a plus.

  • Experience navigating regulatory frameworks for unmanned aircraft operations (U.S. and international is a plus).

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical and regulatory concepts clearly and persuasively to both regulators and internal teams.

  • History of collaborating cross-functionally in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

  • Strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate in a fast-paced environment with competing demands on your time.

  • Obsessive focus on customer success.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain complicated topics--such as autonomy--to regulators and partners.

Ability to travel to client sites and attend technical validation events, as required (including international).

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. jobs.title: PCB Layout Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

At Skydio, we’re building the world’s most intelligent autonomous drones. We’re looking for a PCB Layout Engineer who can execute on complex layouts, while also working cross functionally with EE, RF, and Mechanical. You’ll set best practices, own challenging boards, and play a key role in ensuring Skydio’s layouts meet world-class performance, reliability, and manufacturability standards.

How you'll make an impact:

  •  Own layout of Skydio’s complex PCBAs for next generation products: outline definition, stack-up design, high-density placement, precision routing, and release to manufacturing.

  • Establish and maintain design standards, libraries, and workflows to ensure consistency and scalability across multiple product generations.

  • Partner closely with electrical, mechanical, RF, and manufacturing engineers to resolve trade-offs and deliver robust, manufacturable designs.

  • Collaborate with PCB fabrication and assembly vendors to ensure impedance control, compliance with DFM/DFT rules, and reliable production yields.

  • Drive continuous improvement in tool flows, library management, and design review processes, including opportunities for automation.

What makes you a good fit:

  •  Deep expertise in hands-on PCB layout for high-speed, high-density, and mixed-signal systems (5+ years preferred).

  • Expert in Cadence Allegro/OrCAD (17.2/25.1), with a proven track record designing and shipping complex boards.

  • Strong grasp of component placement, signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC, and impedance control principles, with practical application in layouts.

  • Proficient in rigid, flex, and rigid-flex PCB design for high-performance embedded systems.

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with experience collaborating across EE, ME, RF, and manufacturing teams.

  • (Nice to have) Familiarity with scripting/automation in PCB tools, PLM systems, or experience with robotics/drones.

  • Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $147,500 - $210,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager, US Army
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

As an Enterprise Account Manager (EAM) supporting the US Army at Skydio, you will be responsible for driving strategic growth and long-term adoption of Skydio solutions across Army organizations. You will lead account strategy, prospect into key Army commands and program offices, and develop a deep understanding of operational missions to position Skydio technology at scale.

You will navigate complex Army organizational structures — from operational units and Portfolio Acquisition Executives (PAE’s) to labs, innovation units, and acquisition commands — to drive mission impact and revenue growth. This is a unique opportunity to help shape Skydio’s Army strategy and accelerate adoption of autonomous UAS capabilities across the force.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Own and execute the overall account strategy for the U.S. Army, driving land-and-expand growth across commands, PAEs, and program offices

  • Identify, qualify, and mature new Army opportunities from pre-solicitation through contract award and post-award expansion

  • Develop and maintain a multi-year Army account plan outlining target organizations, funding pathways, transition strategies, and competitive positioning

  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline to meet and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets

  • Engage operational units, requirements owners, acquisition professionals, and senior leadership to align Skydio solutions with mission needs

  • Navigate Army acquisition pathways including programs of record, OTA agreements, IDIQs, and other contracting vehicles

  • Maintain knowledge of Army UAS programs, modernization priorities, doctrine, standards, and policy initiatives

  • Coordinate with Sales Operations, Capture, Contracts, and Customer Success to ensure successful execution of contract milestones and fielding plans

  • Gather and share competitive intelligence regarding Army UAS competitors, contract activity, and program developments

  • Provide structured feedback to Product Management regarding Army-specific capability gaps, feature requests, and operational requirements

  • Partner with Customer Success to support demos, evaluations, pilots, training events, and field deployments

What Makes You a Good Fit:

  • 8+ years of successful enterprise hardware, software, or SaaS sales experience, with a strong preference for Army-focused federal sales

  • Proven track record of managing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals within the U.S. Army

  • Deep understanding of Army organizational structure (PAEs, PMs, TRADOC, AFC, FORSCOM, etc.)

  • Strong knowledge of federal acquisition processes, Army contracting vehicles, and funding mechanisms

  • Experience supporting RDT&E efforts and transitioning capabilities into Army programs of record

  • Familiarity with Army modernization priorities and operational UAS employment concepts

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager,  US Navy, US Marine Corps, and IC/SOCOM
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

As an Enterprise Account Manager (EAM) supporting the US Navy, US Marine Corps, and IC/SOCOM accounts at Skydio, you will drive strategic growth and mission adoption of Skydio solutions across maritime, expeditionary, and special operations communities. You will lead account strategy, identify and mature opportunities, and build trusted relationships across operational commands, program offices, and acquisition organizations.

You will navigate complex defense and intelligence community structures — from fleet and MEF-level operators to PAEs, SYSCOMs, SOCOM components, and IC mission directorates — to deliver operational value and scalable deployments. This is a unique opportunity to shape Skydio’s footprint across maritime, expeditionary, and special mission environments

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Own and execute the account strategy for Navy, Marine Corps, and IC/SOCOM portfolios, driving land-and-expand growth across operational and acquisition stakeholders

  • Identify, qualify, and mature opportunities from pre-solicitation through award and post-award expansion

  • Develop multi-year account plans outlining target commands, funding pathways (O&M, RDT&E, procurement), transition strategies, and competitive positioning

  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline to meet and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets

  • Engage fleet operators, Marine expeditionary units, special operations components, intelligence mission owners, and acquisition professionals to align Skydio capabilities to mission needs

  • Navigate diverse acquisition pathways including Programs of Record, OTAs, IDIQs, SBIR transitions, SOCOM-specific contracting authorities, and IC procurement channels

  • Maintain working knowledge of Navy and USMC UAS programs, maritime and expeditionary doctrine, SOCOM capability priorities, and IC mission requirements

  • Coordinate with Sales Operations, Capture, Contracts, and Customer Success to ensure successful contract execution, delivery timelines, and fielding plans

  • Support demonstrations, shipboard/expeditionary evaluations, special mission pilots, and operational exercises in partnership with Customer Success

  • Gather and share competitive intelligence related to maritime, tactical ISR, and special mission UAS competitors

jobs.title: Communications Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role

Skydio is the leading U.S.-based drone manufacturer and world leader in autonomous flight, building AI-powered flying robots that help public safety agencies, utilities, national security partners, and enterprise customers operate more safely and effectively. From enabling Drone as First Responder (DFR) programs to supporting critical infrastructure inspections and national security missions, our technology is deployed where reliability, intelligence, and autonomy matter most.

We are looking for a Communications Manager based out of NY or DC. As Communications Manager, you will help tell these stories to the world. This role sits at the intersection of media relations, social media, and customer storytelling. If you’re energized by turning real-world missions into headlines, social momentum, and lasting brand equity, this role is for you.

How you'll make an impact

  • Lead customer storytelling initiatives that showcase real-world impact across public safety (DFR programs), utilities, and national security; build and maintain relationships with customers across verticals and provide ongoing support to highlight their programs in their commuaities, in trade spaces, and nationally/internationally

  • Grow Skydio’s media relations efforts, proactively drive coverage in support of the company’s mission

  • Execute the social media strategy across key platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, X), amplifying customer wins, product milestones, and thought leadership to engage a broad audience. Identify new opportunities and creative executions on other platforms, test and learn

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, Growth, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing to uncover powerful stories and translate technical capabilities into clear, compelling messaging

  • Support employee voices, help build public profiles for internal experts, generate awareness and affinity for the brand

  • Support event communications: pre-event outreach, live coverage, post-event follow-up

What makes you a good fit

  • Demonstrated experience in media relations in both traditional and new media

  • Exceptional storytelling skills, with the ability to distill complex technology into narratives that resonate with broad audiences, and the ability to learn technical concepts quickly

  • Strong understanding of social media strategy, content performance, trendspotting, and audience engagement

  • Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and execute with precision

  • Passion for mission-driven technology and a desire to shape the narrative around autonomy, AI, and American manufacturing

  • Experience in issues management

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000*. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. About the role:

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Supply Chain Intern to support our supply chain and operations team. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

As a Buyer at Skydio, you will bring your supply chain and materials management knowledge and skills to enable our growth by driving dynamic Purchase Order management for our drones and docks, and visionary future products in a highly regulated environment. Your impact will be felt throughout the organization when customer orders are shipped on time and valuation of the company increases.

  • Maintain vendor and component information in ERP systems, including Standard Cost, Lead Time, MOQ, Logistics Lead Time, Payment Terms, etc.

  • Manage Purchase Orders end-to-end to support customer orders and company revenue targets. Mitigate supply chain risks and ensure supply continuity, including PO release, delivery commit, receipts and discrepancies, invoice approval and supplier corrective actions as needed.

  • Improve ERP system accuracy and expand capabilities to build a world class MRP for in house manufacturing.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders on implementing supply chain strategies and provide key delivery data for Clear-to-Build report.

  • Analyze procurement data and report on metrics including on-time delivery, PO status, vendor performance etc.

  • Support the development of key planning metrics and reports including Safety Stock Analysis, Inventory Health, Order Policies, and Cash Flow.

  • Participate in cross functional teams and support continuous improvement initiatives for cost, quality, delivery, and inventory management.

How you will make an impact:

This position plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and scalability of drone systems by securing the right materials at the right time and cost. No parts = no drones. You ensure critical components (chips, sensors, motors, batteries) are available when engineering and manufacturing need them, preventing costly delays. This ensures prototypes, builds, and production on schedule. Additionally this individual will play a key role in reducing BOM cost and improving gross margin.

What makes you a strong fit:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain (preferably in aerospace, robotics, or electronics manufacturing).

  • Strong understanding of supply chain principles and procurement best practices.

  • Experience sourcing electronic components (PCBs, semiconductors), mechanical parts, or aerospace materials.

  • Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite).

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and analytical skills.

  • Experience in drone, UAV, aerospace, or high-tech hardware industries.

  • Familiarity with FAA regulations or aerospace quality standards (e.g., AS9100).

  • Knowledge of global sourcing and international logistics.

  • APICS certification (e.g., CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.

  • Strategic sourcing and cost optimization

  • Supplier relationship management

  • Problem-solving and decision-making

  • Attention to detail and organization

  • Cross-functional collaboration

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $120k - $198k*. This role blends workplace experience, office operations, and HR coordination, ensuring a seamless and high-quality experience for employees, visitors, and partners.

You will be the face of the office and a key member of the People team—creating a welcoming, well-organized environment while supporting core HR processes across the employee lifecycle.

How you’ll make an impact:

Workplace Experience & Office Operations

  • Act as a point of contact for employee inquiries related to policies, benefits, and general HR processes

  • Support compliance with Swiss employment regulations and internal policies

  • Assist with reporting, audits, and administrative HR tasks

  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Mobile Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Android Engineer who thinks like a product engineer — someone who doesn't just write code, but understands why it matters to the operator holding the controller. You'll work at the intersection of Skydio's autonomous flight engine, connected cloud services, and physical controller hardware to build products that give drone operators superpowers. From dispatch-to-flight workflows to real-time situational awareness to mission planning, you'll shape how people interact with the most advanced autonomous drones in the world. This isn't just mobile development — it's building the command interface for a new category of intelligent machine.

About the Team:

The Edge Experience team owns the full pilot experience on Skydio's controllers — from the radio link and video streaming pipeline all the way up to the product interfaces that operators rely on in the field. We believe in shipping incrementally, automating the critical path, and measuring what matters. Every feature we build touches real hardware, real airspace, and real missions — and we hold ourselves to the standard that our software must be reliable, performant, and intuitive enough for high-stress, high-stakes operation.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Design intuitive, high-performance operator interfaces for real-time drone control, video streaming, and mission management

  • Work cross-functionally with autonomy, firmware, cloud, and product teams to translate complex system capabilities into simple, reliable user experiences

  • Architect and build product features that bridge our C++ autonomy engine, Android application layer, and cloud services — owning the full vertical from native libraries through JNI/NDK to the Kotlin UI

  • Build and leverage AI-powered agentic workflows to accelerate engineering velocity — from automated testing and code generation to intelligent developer tooling

  • Champion the product engineer mindset: deeply understand operator needs, think end-to-end from hardware to cloud, and own outcomes — not just outputs

  • Mentor engineers and raise the bar on software quality, system design, and user-centric thinking

What Makes You a Good Fit:

  • 3-5+ years professional software engineering experience, with substantial work in both C++ and Android (Kotlin/Java)

  • Deep experience with the Android NDK and JNI — you've built and debugged native libraries that ship in production Android apps

  • Proficiency in Kotlin and the modern Android ecosystem (Coroutines, Jetpack/Architecture Components, Gradle)

  • Previous experience with one or more graphics APIs such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, or Metal

  • Strong debugging and profiling skills across the native/managed boundary (ASan, Perfetto, Android Studio profilers)

  • Experience with low-latency network communication (UDP, WebRTC, or custom protocols)

  • Track record of shipping mobile apps that integrate with hardware, IoT devices, or robots

  • Proficiency in Linux development environments

Nice To Haves:

  • Have shipped mobile apps that integrate with IoT devices or robots

  • Experience with Bazel build system

  • AOSP or Android platform/framework-level experience

  • Familiarity with video codecs (H.264/H.265), camera pipelines, or real-time media processing

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $170,000 - $240,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:
We deliver life-saving information as fast as possible to our customers. They need to securely engage with our cloud every minute of every day, and our North Star is that stronger security, broader compliance, and more flexible deployment models must never slow or fracture that experience. Our vision is to give customers the flexibility and security they require — multi-cloud, multi-region, and government-grade compliance — without any tradeoffs in speed, reliability, or ease of use.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own and execute the Cloud Platform & Infrastructure roadmap, delivering the multi-cloud, multi-region and government-compliant platform capabilities Skydio needs to scale globally for federal, state & local, and commercial customers. You will also own Skydio’s on-prem product line—productizing air-gapped and self-hosted deployments into a scalable, secure, and high-impact solution.

This senior individual-contributor role is about turning field and sales pain into a tightly scoped, customer-centric roadmap and driving the cross-functional programs that bring it to market. You’ll work closely with SRE, cloud engineering, security & compliance, legal, GTM, and executive leadership to build the platform foundations that unlock growth — all while protecting the fast, simple, frictionless experience our customers depend on.

Location

This position is based onsite 5 days/week at our HQ in San Mateo, CA. We offer relocation assistance if needed.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Customer & sales engagement: Run discovery with government and commercial customers: Surface the “why”, build business case for investment, validate proposed solutions in the field, and help grow the business by providing platform capabilities with clearly communicated delivery expectations.

  • Own the platform roadmap for Cloud Platform & Infrastructure: work with sales, customer success, deployment engineers, and customers to convert recurring pain and opportunities into a prioritized, outcome-focused platform roadmap with clear user stories and success criteria.

  • Productize and deliver Skydio On-Prem: define the roadmap for air-gapped and self-hosted offerings; lead cross-functional delivery (engineering, SRE, security, legal, GTM); own releases, onboarding/runbooks and launch artifacts; run pilots/rollouts to cut time-to-deploy and manual effort while preserving a secure, frictionless experience; and support exponential growth in the national security dock business.

  • Drive compliance and certification programs (FedRAMP, CJIS, and other regulatory frameworks): translate compliance requirements into product, engineering, and operational requirements; run cross-functional programs to achieve and maintain Authority to Operate (ATO) and other certifications.

  • Release & expectation management: Coordinate release planning, cut-downs and “what’s in/what’s out” decisions, and communicate release tradeoffs to internal teams and customers. Ensure customer feedback and bug reports are tracked and routed into the right engineering backlog.

  • Compliance enablement: Translate FedRAMP/CJIS/other regulatory requirements into product and operational requirements; run cross-functional compliance programs and vendor/auditor interactions to achieve certification readiness. You will coordinate auditors, security, legal and engineering — not act as the security architect.

  • Evangelize & enable: Explain platform capabilities across the org, create internal playbooks/artifacts, and help GTM teams present platform value to customers.

What would make you a strong fit:

  • 2+ years product experience shipping cloud platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products; 1+ years in senior/lead product roles delivering large, cross-functional technical programs.

  • Demonstrated track record of turning customer pain into a prioritized roadmap and driving cross-functional programs to completion.

  • Deep federal/regulatory domain knowledge or field experience working with federal/defense/regulatory customers (FedRAMP, CJIS, DoD RMF, or similar). You can translate regulatory controls into product requirements and run the organizational work streams to meet them.

  • Track record of shipping platform features that materially improved reliability, scalability, security, and/or cost. Comfortable making tradeoffs and driving decisions with incomplete data.

  • Strong program management and stakeholder influence skills — you can align engineering, security, legal, sales, and customers toward common goals without formal authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience briefing executives and external auditors.

  • This role will be driving the development of products for our military customers, and is subject to a government contract that requires Skydio to limit this position to candidates with US Citizenship. We welcome every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States to apply. However, at this time, Skydio does not currently offer employment-based visa or permanent residency sponsorship for this role.

  • Ability to obtain FAA Part 107 certification within 60 days of employment start.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $170,000 - $215,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

jobs.title: Director, Growth Marketing - Commercial
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

Skydio is seeking an experienced Growth Marketing leader to accelerate pipeline and revenue growth within our commercial segment. This is a hands-on role that leads strategic planning and orchestration of high-performing campaigns, delivering measurable results against aggressive pipeline targets.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute segment-specific go-to-market strategies for physical security and energy/utilities, including tailored messaging, channel mix, and campaign approaches that resonate with buying committees

  • Quarterback cross-functional teams, including digital marketing, content, social media, event marketing, email/lifecycle, customer marketing, and channel partners, to plan and execute integrated campaigns.

  • Design and run account-based marketing (ABM) programs targeting high-value accounts within priority segments, coordinating personalized outreach across digital, events, and direct channels

  • Own the development and management of the overall commercial marketing program calendar. Ensure stakeholders understand what programs and activities are planned and executed

  • Analyze pipeline and marketing data regularly to report on campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Use insights to optimize ongoing and future campaigns to exceed growth targets

  • Manage contractors and marketing budgets efficiently, ensuring spend is aligned with program objectives and delivers positive returns

  • Continuously test and iterate on marketing tactics, channels, and technologies, including A/B testing, funnel experiments, and new platform evaluation, to improve campaign effectiveness and ROI. Document and share learnings with the broader team

  • Own Skydio's presence at key industry trade shows, roadshows, conferences, and events. Plan and execute a regular cadence of webinars, live demos, and virtual events that showcase Skydio's capabilities to target buyers and generate qualified pipeline

What Success Looks Like:

  • Measurable growth in pipeline and market share within target segments, with clear attribution to your marketing programs

  • Consistently exceeding pipeline and revenue targets through well-architected, multi-channel campaigns with strong ROI discipline

  • Repeatable, scalable campaign playbooks that become a model for the broader marketing organization

  • A reputation as the go-to marketing partner for commercial growth, with strong relationships across sales, product, and GTM leadership


What Would Make You a Good Fit:

  • 7–10 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or integrated B2B marketing, preferably in technology, industrial, or hardware companies selling to multi-layered buying teams

  • Proven track record of building and scaling integrated growth marketing programs that generated $100MM+ in pipeline, with the ability to articulate how you did it and what you learned

  • Exceptional at managing multiple initiatives simultaneously with a clear eye for details and the ability to prioritize effectively to meet tight deadlines without compromising quality

  • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience building dashboards, articulating attribution models, and compiling performance reports that translate data into actionable program decisions

  • Significant experience leading and influencing cross-functional teams and partners to execute programs and achieve goals without direct authority

  • Hands-on experience with marketing tools and platforms including Salesforce, Marketo, common paid ad platforms (Google, LinkedIn, Meta), Google Analytics, ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini

  • Creative mindset—you think about the audience, message, and approach, continuously questioning how we can improve the execution and results

  • Strong messaging and copywriting skills

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

Skydio is looking for a driven customer facing Program Manager with a deep sense of ownership to lead and drive all aspects of implementation and delivery for our Law Enforcement Customers.

You will join our Customer Success team, and will be Skydio's Law Enforcement customer liaison and broadly responsible for the success of our contracts to include: cost, performance, scheduling, project planning, technical execution, risk management and problem solving. In this role, you will have to learn technical concepts and employ them quickly. Digging into the details to understand program dependencies so that technical and program risks can be managed effectively is a must. You will be expected to utilize your technical capability in conjunction with your program management skills to deliver the best outcome for the customer. A successful candidate for this job should have deep experience working within the U.S. Law Enforcement and experience engaging with high-level officials.

In addition to your core role, you will also be suited to providing input into a wide range of technical activities within the company. You will work in a high-activity/fast-paced environment, with the ability to handle ambiguity, and multiple tasks or projects at once. Your teammates are passionate Customer Success and Technical Support teams, but also with broader teams such as Product, Marketing, Development and Engineering teams.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Be a highly collaborative, requirements driven planner with a deep sense of ownership and accountability with a willingness to roll up sleeves and dive into the details.

  • Plan and design end-to-end project deployment and integration activities to ensure the successful launch of our platform and ensure operational success. Manage production and implementation programs against cost, schedule and technical requirements.

  • Understand customer requirements and translate them to Skydio’s agile product and technical teams to drive development and delivery execution.

  • Establish relationships with the Law Enforcement customer and be technical enough to build & drive plans with Skydio’s engineering team’s to meet milestones.

  • Inform Skydio and customer business and program leaders regarding contract management risks and opportunities, ensuring a coordinated and comprehensive approach to product delivery across the program.

  • General support of go-to-market & business activities as required.

What Makes You A Good Fit:

  • Experience as a customer-facing professional services / program manager / customer success, or in a similar high-tier complex and multifaceted role preferably for law enforcement agencies.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including interaction with senior leaders and a strong focus on project management tools and concepts.

  • Proven track record of implementing new technology, agile development and interfacing with technical teams to deliver on customer schedules.

  • Experience in implementing effective internal business systems, processes and controls (hardware, software, operations) for management of large scale customer projects in the Law Enforcement field

  • Experience with Law Enforcement and commercial Unmanned Aircraft Systems and related software development.

  • Law Enforcement/Federal Program Management experience, to include: Technology Assessments, Systems Design, Systems Analysis, Programmatic Support, Acquisition Planning, and Budget Planning.

  • Outstanding analytical thinker and problem solver, comfortable working in data analytics and able to resolve complex problems independently. Thinking ‘out of the box’ and to develop creative solutions

  • Strong location preference for Oahu, HI

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $160,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. jobs.title: Product Support Engineer Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role: Skydio is looking for a highly motivated individual currently enrolled or recently graduated from a hardware-related engineering degree program to intern with the Skydio Product Support Engineer (PSE) team this summer. During this 8-10 week program, you’ll utilize your knowledge of electrical/mechanical engineering along with basic software skills to assist in root cause failure investigations, triage technical customer failure escalation reports to various Skydio Engineering teams, and work with the manufacturing teams on quality improvement signals coming from customers. You’ll also collaborate with other PSEs to perform key operational tasks along with tool and process improvements benefiting Technical Support Representatives (TSR) and Product Engineering teams. This role is ideal for someone looking to gain practical insights into how IoT products are designed, built, and supported as they prepare to enter the full-time employment market.

Location: This is an office-based 40-hour/week position that requires at least 3 days/week onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Assist with customer failure analysis triage involving Skydio drones, docks, and accessories.

  • Assist with work to identify product failures that require Engineering or Manufacturing changes.

  • Help with proactive product quality initiatives involving customers and product updates/upgrades.

  • Make improvements to diagnostic processes used by Skydio Support team TSRs to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues.

  • Assist other PSEs in creating content for weekly/monthly feature/bug prioritization and planning meetings with Product teams.

  • Assist TSRs and PSEs in swarming high-priority product incidences to mitigate operational downtime risk.

  • Build analytics dashboards in Databricks and use data to inform decision making.

What makes you a good fit:

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering (or a related field).

  • Have basic software development knowledge, preferably with c++, Python, Cloud VMs, analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks/SQL) and a solid grasp of AI (e.g., Claude, LLMs).

  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, and familiarity with triage and escalation workflows.

  • Understanding of network architecture/troubleshooting for WiFi and 5G LTE cellular networks.

  • Experience performing hardware failure analysis and related tasks at a project level.

  • Familiarity with autonomous robotics and IoT software concepts.

  • Ability to work autonomously, with excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to efficiently collaborate with others to quickly create high-impact solutions.

Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $47/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Graduate students, and $58/hr for PhD students*. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Interns are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

jobs.title: Hardware Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role: We are looking for a highly hands-on Hardware Technician to support rapid prototyping, 3D printing, and lab improvement across multiple engineering spaces. This role focuses on operating and maintaining SLA and FDM printers, supporting mechanical assembly, and keeping labs organized and functional. You will spend most of your time on your feet—moving between labs, fabricating parts, assembling hardware, and supporting engineers in a fast-paced environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Operate and maintain 3D printers, including troubleshooting and material handling

  • Support rapid prototyping by fabricating and finishing parts using shop tools and basic fabrication equipment

  • Perform mechanical assembly, including drone hardware and similar systems

  • Install, modify, and maintain lab and shop infrastructure such as benches, shelving, and test equipment

  • Maintain organization and functionality across shared lab spaces

  • Move between multiple labs and tasks throughout the day to support engineering teams

  • Independently identify and execute the highest priority tasks in a fast-paced lab environment

What Makes You a Good Fit:

  • Strong hands-on experience with 3D printing, including machine operation, basic troubleshooting, and material handling

  • Experience using shop tools such as saws, drill presses, sanders, and other fabrication equipment

  • Experience with mechanical assembly, ideally including multirotors, RC aircraft, or similar systems

  • Experience setting up or improving lab or shop environments (e.g., mounting equipment, building workstations, organizing shared spaces)

  • Comfortable working on your feet and moving between multiple tasks and locations throughout the day

  • Ability to proactively identify and execute the highest priority work in a fast-paced environment

  • Familiarity with general lab operations, including consumables management and maintenance routines

  • Experience with machining tools such as manual or CNC mills is a plus

  • Basic experience with soldering, wiring, or cable harnessing is a plus

  • Experience with CAD tools such as Fusion is a plus

  • Ability to obtain FAA Part 107 certification within 60 days of employment start

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the team: Skydio’s Cloud infrastructure team is here to ensure that the Skydio Cloud platform is always available to our customers when they need it: whether that’s performing a routine bridge inspection or it’s aiding in rescue operations during a natural disaster. With thousands of drones operating all over the world, we are constantly improving the continuous delivery and deployment of our infrastructure.

About the role: As an Infrastructure Engineer on our product, you’ll not just be responsible for supporting our Kubernetes fleet, but also making software changes to the core product in order to support the use cases that we need. This is a hybrid software and infrastructure role, meaning that sometimes the best solution is to fix the product, not automate around the deficiencies. This is a role for someone that enjoys having the freedom to operate across the whole stack, and the ability to affect the architecture, security, and functionality of the product.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Re-architect and maintain the ever growing needs on our Kubernetes fleet and its supporting infrastructure.

  • Continually improve and expand the continuous delivery of the product.

  • Work in cross-functional teams (from hardware to cloud) to build new capabilities for the platform.

  • Work directly with security to continually improve the practices and controls that will keep our customer’s data and drones safe.

  • Drive cost saving initiatives early into Skydio’s product, so that it scales over time.

What makes you a good fit:

  • 2+ years of experience as a platform engineer, DevOps or equivalent infrastructure role.

  • Can comfortably debug and automate Kubernetes clusters.

  • Not hesitant to jump into the code to fix the underlying issue (Python or Go preferred).

  • Prior experience implementing continuous deployment systems.

  • Understand cloud platforms architecture, especially networking, security, storage, and resilient application topologies.

  • Ability and interest in being delegated business objectives and seeking out the solutions.

Bonus points:

  • Familiarity with supporting both SaaS and self-hosted applications.

  • Experience with supporting drones or highly automated physical hardware.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. jobs.title: Field Support Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the team:

The National Security Mission Success team is a growing international team that provides the broader organization and our customers with enablement services to ensure that our customers can get the most value out of their Skydio UAS solutions. Reporting to the Field Support Representative Manager, the Field Support Representative will primarily interface with the National Security sales team, Customer Support and Program Management to support our International Defense and Government customers.

About the role:

We are looking for a highly-motivated and technical individual with UAS experience who is comfortable interfacing with Defense and Government customers as well as other Federal and enterprise customers to provide best-in-class onsite and remote technical and logistics support. By taking ownership of customer relationships in the field and collecting feedback, you will be a trusted partner and liaison between Program Management, Product, Support and Engineering. You will advise both Skydio and the Customer, expediting the product feedback communication loop and helping manage the customer technical enablement, troubleshooting, repair and maintenance workstreams.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Work closely with internal teams to become an expert on Skydio’s products, processes, specifications, and product roadmap.

  • Develop field support processes that define and accelerate our escalation and debugging workflows.

  • Reduce the number of technical escalations into engineering groups by developing effective triage and resolution techniques.

  • Develop and maintain an advanced level of proficiency in product enablement and troubleshooting by becoming a certified Skydio UAS Operator and Trainer.

  • Provide on-the-job (OJT) training to customers in the areas of maintenance and operation techniques relevant to the repair of UAS aircraft and equipment, including associated test equipment, with special attention given to adjustment, calibration, spares recommendation, trouble-shooting and inspection methods.

  • Work to develop or improve written inspection procedures, drawings and other instructions to perform and help customers inspect and maintain their fleets.

  • Provide on-site company representation and technical support to customers and initiate corrective actions for maintenance, repair and replacement issues.

What makes you a good fit:

  • Ability to travel up to 80%+ Globally to provide field support to our Federal and Defense customers.

  • 3+ years experience as a Field Support Representative operating on, repairing and maintaining UAS (Unmanned Aircraft Systems) for large clients, preferably with government or military customers.

  • Adept at technical troubleshooting, problem-solving, and are familiar with triage and escalation workflows.

  • Assertive self-starter with excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.

  • OCONUS (deployed) military experience is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with RMA, spares, logistics or other repair workflows is preferred.

  • Experience in Linux operating systems is preferred.

  • Experience with military standard maintenance practices is preferred.

  • Existing or prior security clearance is preferred.

  • Creative thinking with the ability to multitask.

  • Unwavering professionalism.

Compensation:
At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $130,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. jobs.title: Autonomy Engineer Intern - Deep Learning (Computational Photography)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

We leverage breakthrough AI to create the world’s most intelligent flying machines for use by our enterprise, public safety, defense and other customers. Learning a semantic and geometric understanding of the world from best-in-class visual data is the core of our autonomy system.

We are pushing the boundaries of what is possible with real-time deep networks to accelerate progress in intelligent aerial robots that can autonomously navigate in unknown environments and deliver operational value to users. Capture and processing of high quality visual data powered by computational photography models and algorithms are key to enabling enhanced camera capabilities and downstream applications such as inspection and mapping, ISR (intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance) and public safety.

If you are excited about real world applications of deep learning and solving difficult problems in imaging, computer vision and autonomy, we would love to hear from you. As a Deep Learning Engineer Intern, you will be responsible for training and deploying optimized models to our products for solving challenging problems such as multimodal scene understanding, computational photography, optical flow and range estimation, object detection, segmentation and tracking, visual localization and mapping, few-shot learning, automated path planning etc…

How you'll make an impact:

  • Design, implement and deploy deep learning models with a particular focus on computational photography applications such as super-resolution, multi-frame denoising, low light imaging, High Dynamic Range (HDR) imaging etc.

  • Leverage massive amounts of real world video and other sensor data for data mining, curation, labeling, training and evaluation

  • Leverage large scale and diverse synthetic data to power deep learning algorithms

  • Leverage state-of-the-art foundation models for knowledge distillation and label efficient learning

  • Refine and optimize models for low-latency on embedded hardware

  • Refine and optimize models for cloud-based deployment in latency tolerant applications

  • Develop evaluation benchmarks and metrics to quantify the performance of autonomous systems

  • Be a generalist helping out on all aspects of the software when needed

What makes you a good fit:

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in computer science, electrical engineering or related discipline

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, training and deploying deep learning models

  • Ability to deliver high quality, well-architected code (Python/PyTorch and preferably, C++)

  • Leverage state-of-the-art academic papers and literature for fast iteration

  • Ability to thrive in a fast paced, collaborative and highly technical team environment

  • Comfortable navigating and delivering within a complex codebase

  • Strong communication skills

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Embedded Software Engineer – Camera Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

Skydio designs and manufactures fully autonomous drones that use state of the art hardware paired with advanced computer vision and machine learning to ensure our users always have access to the visual information they need. As a key member of our end-to-end imaging team, you will leverage deep expertise in ISP pipelines and Linux-based SoCs to architect and develop cutting-edge camera subsystems for both current and next-generation products.

About the Team:

We design camera systems that support autonomous navigation, professional media capture, and industrial inspection and situational awareness. From early-stage user needs analysis to mass production, we manage the entire lifecycle: requirements definition, hardware bring-up, tuning, and validation. We work closely with the broader software organization to lay a strong foundation for the rest of the stack.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Lead development and integration of camera subsystems

  • Design and bring up ISP and camera hardware

  • Configure and optimize ISP and encoder pipelines

  • Collaborate with image quality, calibration, and test teams to deliver production-ready camera software

  • Develop next-generation image processing algorithms for autonomous flight applications

  • Bring up and debug new hardware platforms and prototypes

What Makes You a Good Fit:

  • Proven experience with ISP development on ARM-based Linux/Android SoCs, especially Qualcomm platforms

  • Deep understanding of ISP pipeline architecture, including front-end, Bayer processing, and post-processing

  • Strong background in algorithm development across CPU, DSP, GPU, and ISP pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with real-time 3A algorithms

  • Familiarity with Android Camera HAL3, Linux V4L2, AVC, and HEVC standards

  • Experience with GStreamer and GPU shader-based implementations for image processing (Debayering, lens shading, etc.)

  • Strong embedded development experience, including firmware for physical hardware

  • Proficiency in modern C++ in real-time, embedded environments

  • Python scripting and development skills

  • Skilled in hardware bring-up, low-level debugging, and performance optimization

  • Commitment to writing clean, maintainable, and well-abstracted code

  • Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

jobs.title: IT Technician (Help Desk - Linux Focus)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role

This is not a traditional help desk role.
We’re looking for a highly technical, hands on IT Technician to support Skydio’s manufacturing environment in Hayward. This role is focused on deep troubleshooting, Linux support, identity systems, and network triage.
You’ll be the frontline technical expert for employees, capable of diagnosing complex issues across Linux systems, identity platforms (Okta, JumpCloud), and on prem network infrastructure.
This role is critical to keeping our manufacturing environment running smoothly and requires someone who is comfortable going deep technically while still being highly responsive and collaborative.

Location

Onsite - 5 days/week, Monday - Friday: 3:30pm - 12am
Skydio Manufacturing (Hayward, CA)

What You’ll Do

Advanced Endpoint & OS Support (Linux first)

  • Troubleshoot complex issues across Linux (primary), macOS, and Windows systems

  • Diagnose OS level problems (performance, services, networking, permissions, etc.)

  • Support engineering and manufacturing workflows running on Linux machines

  • Perform system provisioning, reimaging, patching, and hardware diagnostics

Identity & Device Management (Okta + JumpCloud)

  • Handle user lifecycle actions in Okta (lockouts, reactivations, group changes, MFA issues)

  • Troubleshoot SSO and access related issues across integrated applications

  • Manage devices in JumpCloud (reenrollment, policy issues, locked devices)

  • Ensure endpoints are properly enrolled, compliant, and operational

Network Troubleshooting & Support

  • Act as first responder for network related issues onsite

  • Troubleshoot connectivity problems (wired & wireless)

  • Assist with:

    • Switch troubleshooting (ports, VLANs, cabling issues)

    • Wireless network issues

    • Identifying outages or degraded performance

  • Partner with the Network Engineer on escalations and implementations

Hands On IT Operations

  • Support hardware lifecycle (deployment, repair, replacement)

  • Assist with manufacturing floor IT needs and rapid response issues

  • Own problems end to end, not just ticket resolution

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Document troubleshooting steps, fixes, and recurring issues

  • Contribute to internal knowledge base and process improvements

  • Identify patterns and proactively reduce repeat issues

What Makes You a Good Fit

Technical Experience

  • 4+ years in a technical IT support role (not entry-level help desk)

  • Strong hands on experience with:

    • Linux troubleshooting (required)

    • macOS and Windows support

  • Experience with Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management)

  • Experience with JumpCloud or similar device management tools

Networking Fundamentals (Important)

  • Solid understanding of:

    • TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP

    • VLANs, switching basics

  • Comfortable troubleshooting:

    • Network drops

    • Port issues

    • Connectivity problems across endpoints

Mindset & Approach

  • Strong problem solver who can go beyond surface level fixes

  • Comfortable working in a fast paced, high interruption environment

  • Proactive - identifies issues before they become recurring problems

  • Tea -oriented and able to work closely with engineering and IT

Nice to Have

  • Certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, Linux+)

  • Experience in manufacturing or lab environments

  • Exposure to scripting/automation (Bash, Python, etc.)

  • Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

 - Diagnose OS level problems (performance, services, networking, permissions, etc.)

 - Perform system provisioning, reimaging, patching, and hardware diagnostics

Identity & Device Management (Okta + JumpCloud)

 - Handle user lifecycle actions in Okta (lockouts, reactivations, group changes, MFA issues)

 - Troubleshoot SSO and access related issues across integrated applications

 - Manage devices in JumpCloud (reenrollment, policy issues, locked devices)

 - Ensure endpoints are properly enrolled, compliant, and operational

Network Troubleshooting & Support

 - Act as first responder for network related issues onsite

 - Troubleshoot connectivity problems (wired & wireless)

 - Assist with:

   - Wireless network issues
   
   - Identifying outages or degraded performance

 - Partner with the Network Engineer on escalations and implementations

Hands On IT Operations

 - Support hardware lifecycle (deployment, repair, replacement)

 - Assist with manufacturing floor IT needs and rapid response issues

 - Own problems end to end, not just ticket resolution

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

 - Document troubleshooting steps, fixes, and recurring issues

 - Contribute to internal knowledge base and process improvements

 - Identify patterns and proactively reduce repeat issues

What Makes You a Good Fit

Technical Experience

 - 4+ years in a technical IT support role (not entry-level help desk)

 - Strong hands on experience with:
   
   - Linux troubleshooting (required)
   
   - macOS and Windows support

 - Experience with Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management)

 - Experience with JumpCloud or similar device management tools

Networking Fundamentals (Important)

 - Solid understanding of:
   
   - TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
   
   - VLANs, switching basics

 - Comfortable troubleshooting:
   
   - Network drops
   
   - Port issues
   
   - Connectivity problems across endpoints

Mindset & Approach

 - Strong problem solver who can go beyond surface level fixes

 - Comfortable working in a fast paced, high interruption environment

 - Proactive - identifies issues before they become recurring problems

 - Tea -oriented and able to work closely with engineering and IT

Nice to Have


 - Certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, Linux+)

 - Experience in manufacturing or lab environments

 - Exposure to scripting/automation (Bash, Python, etc.)

 - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.
